name: kuaishou-mcp
description: Kuaishou (social): me, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_kuaishou_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_APP_ID
platform_mcp_kuaishou_app_id.description: app_id of your Kuaishou Open Platform application (https://open.kuaishou.com/platform).

platform_mcp_kuaishou_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_kuaishou_app_secret.description: app_secret of the same application; sent only to /oauth2/refresh_token.

platform_mcp_kuaishou_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_kuaishou_refresh_token.description: The user's refresh_token from the 快手登录 authorization-code exchange (/oauth2/access_token, scopes user_info, user_video_info, user_video_delete; valid 180 days). It is single-use: every refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set; 'refreshToken.discarded' means an old one was reused).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /openapi/user_info (scope user_info): name, sex, fan, follow, head, city of the authorising user.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: POST /openapi/photo/delete (删除视频) removes one of the user's works by photo_id; 120001 = work does not exist.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: GET /openapi/photo/info (查询单一视频详情, scope user_video_info): like_count, comment_count, view_count, caption, create_time (ms), pending.
